commands.procedure: На own candidate по уже записанному D25 check-profile выполнить Pint --test для перечисленных там фактически изменённых/новых owning PHP файлов (root binary scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pint; sibling binary ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pint, cwd своего пакета). Пустой PHP impact отмечается non-applicable с основанием. PHPStan core: scripts/php84 vendor/bin/phpstan analyse -c phpstan.neon --memory-limit=1G --no-progress, cwd root. Для каждого фактически затронутого sibling: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=512M --no-progress, cwd packages/name из check-profile. Чужие dirty файлы не включать. Каждый исполненный command/cwd/list/env/exit сохранить; это exact impact-derived procedure по D25, не file filter для PHPStan.
commands.expect: Все соответствующие exact commands имеют exit 0, skipped/deferred не GREEN

commands.procedure:
Adversarial self-check модели P3-invariants: отметить применимые invariants/enforcement/callers/negative cases и lock pair matrix. Для нового guard ограниченный negative control: в isolated временной копии отключить одну owning проверку, запустить её именованный acceptance тест и получить RED, восстановить исходный SHA-256 и подтвердить GREEN. Сохранить command/cwd/env/exit/fingerprint. Не запускать mutation campaign. Supplemental D06 controls ALL required, fault definition in P3-security-contracts#Acceptance; each executed only inside isolated temporary repository copy, cwd relative to that isolated root, same env. Exact commands:
NC-ADMISSION: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Uploads/P3/DestinationScanPolicyTest.php --filter=SEC-R03
NC-EVIDENCE: cwd=.; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci packages/core/tests/Content/ScanEvidenceBoundaryTest.php --filter=SEC-R06
NC-WORK: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Uploads/P3/ScanWorkRecoveryTest.php --filter=SEC-R09
NC-BACKFILL: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Uploads/P3/ScanWorkRecoveryTest.php --filter=SEC-BACKFILL
NC-FENCE: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=pgsql DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=5432 DB_DATABASE=vaulter_test DB_USERNAME=vaulter DB_PASSWORD=secret ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Concurrency/ScanWorkRecoveryRaceTest.php --filter=SEC-R11
NC-QUARANTINE: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Uploads/P3/ContentDeliveryBoundaryTest.php --filter=SEC-R17
NC-DIRECT: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Uploads/P3/ContentDeliveryBoundaryTest.php --filter=SEC-R16
NC-CLEANUP: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Uploads/P3/CompleteUploadIdempotencyTest.php --filter=SEC-R13
Each control requires named matched test>=1/skipped=0, injected RED then exact source SHA restoration and original GREEN; receipts cannot substitute unrelated tests or silent skipped filters. No product controls run in design.
NC-ROLLOUT: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Uploads/P3/ScanPolicyTransitionTest.php --filter=SEC-POLICY-two-boundaries
NC-CURSOR: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Uploads/P3/ScanWorkRecoveryTest.php --filter=SEC-RECOVERY-bounds
Same isolated-copy RED/restoration/GREEN/count requirements.
